name: Embers, Greater
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as embers except it deals 3 fire damage per round and if the target critically fails their saving throw, they are nauseated for until the beginning of their next turn.
